title: Collapse of the entangled quantum polynomial hierarchy to one-turn quantum refereed games

standard_prerequisites.name: Sion minimax, standard quantum state convexity and Hoeffding concentration
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author exact imported statements and complete bibliography retained; local extension-set, game-reduction and sparse-strategy proofs remain included.

core_obligations: Show the extension sets of compatible density matrices are compact and convex.
Eliminate entangled quantifier levels by minimax and identify the surviving second level with one-turn refereed games.
difficulty_reason: Uses convexity of partial-trace extension sets and a minimax interchange to eliminate alternating entangled quantum quantifiers while preserving the game value. The collapse lemma and game-class equality are grouped as one principal result; polynomial-round and error-parameter consequences remain uncounted.
